title: Customer access management and DAIP readiness packet
non_goals: staff password viewing or manual password setting
permanent deletion of linked customer business history
security_controls: email is the client sign-in identifier; no separate username
generic account recovery responses do not reveal account existence
opaque raw reset tokens are never stored or returned to admin screens
new reset/setup emails retire prior unexpired tokens of the same type
single-use token claim uses an atomic used_at is null filter
password reset revokes existing sessions before creating a new one
customer profile/account actions have safe audit events
archive blocks sign-in while preserving historical links

role_model.administrator: suspend, restore, and archive lifecycle actions

daip_boundary: Build 220 adds a written Phase 1 readiness packet only. DAIP Gates C-F remain held and no customer asset handling is enabled.
